_about: Response policy. This is not measured and not learned: it is your team's decision about how serious each hazard is once the fusion model detects it. Edit freely. Zone levels: ELEVATED, WARNING, CRITICAL, CATASTROPHIC. SMS alerts fire at CRITICAL and above.

CLEAR: No trained hazard detected. Continue the sweep.
WARNING: Hazard detected. Alert the response team.
CRITICAL: Serious hazard detected. Keep people out and dispatch responders.
CATASTROPHIC: Multiple serious hazards or people in danger. Evacuate and notify all agencies.

guidance.GAS_LEAK: Gas: no ignition sources, shut off supply
guidance.SPILL_HAZARD: Spill: keep clear, identify the substance
guidance.SURVIVOR_SIGNAL: Search: locate the source of the sound
